details.autoHelp: After the immediate reply goes out from AgentSDR, this sequence's follow-ups are drafted by the AI and sent on their own — at most one every 30 minutes (by default; see Sending rules) from each mailbox, LinkedIn account or WhatsApp number, inside its sending hours. The immediate reply always waits for you. Turning this off moves waiting follow-ups to Action required.

timeline.footer: A new inbound reply interrupts any pending follow-up. Every message waits for human approval; nothing sends on its own.
